info.name: Demo NEAPS V2 with REST Query
info.description:
The purpose of this collection is to demo the use of the NEAPS v2 REST APIs for the development lifecycle of a custom NE audit capability using the REST query to audit all ETHERNET PTP entities (Layer 2 endpoints) of a selected PN10x NE.

This type of NE interaction pattern is supported for audit. Fix is not supported.

For details about NEAPS check this Ciena internal page: [NEAPS On-line Help](https://confluence.ciena.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=MCPRD&title=MCPA+NEAPS+On-line+Help)

The collection is stored in Ciena bitbucket mcp-docs repository at [modules/api-guide/assets/attachments/NeapsV2WithRestQueryApiGuide.postman_collection.json](https://bitbucket.ciena.com/projects/BP_MCP_SERVICES/repos/mcp-docs/browse/modules/api-guide/pages)

# Preliminary Setup

Set the Variables used by this collection

- NMC_SERVER - the HTTP address of the Navigator MC server
- NE_NAME - the name of the PN10x NE to query for NE config data
- NE_FUNCTION - the NE audit capability label demonstrated by this collection
